thread.title: Netflix Will Probably Make Its Earnings Number, Jim Cramer Says

author: Justin Ho
title: Netflix Will Probably Make Its Earnings Number, Jim Cramer Says
text:
Jim Cramer thinks Netflix ( NFLX ) will likely hit analyst estimates when it reports earnings Thursday after the bell, as analysts who've recently upgraded the stock probably scaled their forecasts accordingly.
"Would all of these analysts really upgrade [Netflix] and would they tell you that they're going to raise [price targets] and then screw you on the quarter? I don't think so," Cramer said earlier Thursday in a live conference call with members of his Actions Alerts PLUS club for investors.
Still, Cramer said that among the so-called FAANG stocks - Facebook ( FB ) , Amazon ( AMZN ) , Apple ( AAPL ) , Netflix and Alphabet/Google ( GOOG ) , ( GOOGL ) - his favorite remains Amazon, which Cramer's charitable trust owns a large position in.
"I think it's terrific," he said. "It went to $2,000 and we didn't sell some, and that was a mistake. But I like [Amazon Web Services CEO] Andy Jassy, I like [Amazon CEO] Jeff Bezos, and I still like Amazon."
